note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate` (the Rust validator) reports for ORB_PAGE_UNREACHABLE on the same program. Each case copies a page.rs reachability test named in its id (validate_page_reachability, collect_href_strings, collect_reachability_signals); the cases without a test name pin a branch of those functions the tests leave open (tick effects, the static navigate prefix, the @pages sigil in app config and in an effect, schema-wide reachability, per-orbital indexes). The lazyPages half of validate_page_reachability is covered by the cases named for its page.rs tests and by the lazy cases beside them, built on the shape `orb resolve --output` serializes (orbRef, orbital, path, links omitted when empty).
